title: Newhalo accordion
description: Questions that open in place, one at a time: 24px questions with a small white plus tile that turns into an orange minus. Two looks: black hairline rows, or borderless rows where the open one becomes a white card. Answers slide open; rows fade in as they scroll into view.
notes: native <details name>: exclusive opening without JavaScript (older browsers allow several open)
name: newhalo-accordion

props.description:
lines: black hairline rows with a white plus tile · cards: no lines; the open item
becomes a white card and its tile turns orange

props.description: a name shared by the items, so opening one closes the others

props.description: index of the item open at first; leave out for all closed
